qa_pair.question: Using discovery, capabilities and workflow in reference fixture version 2, an editor wants to keep a user-valued reference while testing five temperature alternatives in a single render_compare call. Can all five alternatives be returned by that one call? Answer True or False.

Consult fixture version 2 history limits and persistence tool descriptions. An editor expects 40 more changes and wants to retain an immutable named reference independently of undo truncation, without changing the current revision. Which advertised tool provides that persistence? Return its complete rapidraw_ name.

From fixture version 2 diagnostics and selective-edit contracts, two enabled masks adjust shadows and colour but have no local exposure contribution. The combined local exposure map is zero. Does that prove these masks have no visible effect? Answer True or False.

Inspect fixture version 2 job tool descriptions and reliability guidance. AI inference is active and the editor wants to stop it while keeping the native engine available for rendering. Which tool requests that behavior rather than cancelling the active MCP request? Return its complete rapidraw_ name.

Read fixture version 2 background-denoise and session-state contracts. A job captures parent revision 12; edits advance that parent to revision 15 while processing runs. Which parent revision supplies the inherited edits of the resulting session? Return only the integer.

Using fixture version 2 job recovery descriptions and workflow, an AI job is interrupted after processing several tiles. The editor reconnects, inspects its persisted status and explicitly resumes the job. Does the advertised recovery continue from a partial-tile checkpoint? Answer True or False.

Consult fixture version 2 linear-mask coordinate schema. A left-to-right horizontal boundary is at source y=250, with fadeBefore=100, fadeAfter=200, and linear falloff. There is no crop, inversion or opacity reduction. At which source y coordinate is native mask coverage half strength before 8-bit quantization? Return only the integer.

Read fixture version 2 comparison and coordinate contracts. A 3000-by-2000 rendered crop has an overview 1500 pixels wide. To compare temperature variants at the detail shown at preview x=750, which x belongs in render_compare.region? Return only the integer.

From fixture version 2 comparison and named-version descriptions, an older named reference and the current edit have identical canvas dimensions but different perspective transforms. Can render_compare promise aligned pixels simply because the dimensions agree? Answer True or False.

Consult fixture version 2 job status, cancellation and start contracts. One job is cancelling but has not reached a terminal status. What is the advertised maximum number of concurrent denoise workers in this workspace, including that worker? Return only the integer.
